description: This file contains core functions for LiteLLM's A2A SDK, including message sending (both sync and async), streaming, client creation, and agent card retrieval. It manages integration with the 'a2a' package, logging, and completion bridging.

classes.name: Logging
classes.description: A class for logging streaming and request details during A2A interactions.

methods.name: _set_usage_on_logging_obj
methods.description: Sets token usage details on the logging object for standard payloads.

methods.name: _set_agent_id_on_logging_obj
methods.description: Sets agent ID on the logging object for SpendLogs tracking.

methods.name: _get_a2a_model_info
methods.description: Extracts agent info, sets model details on logging, and returns agent name.

methods.name: asend_message
methods.description: Asynchronous function to send a message to an A2A agent, with optional completion bridge routing.

methods.name: send_message
methods.description: Synchronous wrapper for asend_message, dispatching based on event loop presence.

methods.name: asend_message_streaming
methods.description: Asynchronous generator to send streaming messages to an A2A agent, with optional completion bridge routing.

methods.name: create_a2a_client
methods.description: Creates and resolves an A2A client for a given agent URL, fetching the agent card.

methods.name: aget_agent_card
methods.description: Fetches the agent card from an A2A agent URL.
